topic.title: Anthropic raises $2B Series D at $60B valuation to scale enterprise AI

sources.title: Anthropic closes $2B round led by Lightspeed

linkedin_post:
Anthropic just raised $2B at a $60B valuation. But the real story isn't the money — it's who's writing the checks and why.

Here's what happened:

Lightspeed led the round, with participation from Salesforce Ventures, Goldman Sachs, and — notably — three Fortune 100 enterprise buyers who are also customers. That last detail is the one worth studying.

When your biggest customers become your investors, it signals something specific: they've seen enough internal ROI to bet their own capital on your future. Anthropic didn't just raise funding — they locked in multi-year enterprise commitments disguised as an investment round.

Why this matters for founders:

• Customer-Led Rounds Are the New Signal: In 2024, the signal was "top-tier VC backed." In 2026, the signal is "my enterprise customers invested in me." It means the product is sticky enough that buyers want to ensure you survive and keep building.

• The Enterprise AI Race Has a Clear Strategy: Anthropic isn't trying to win on benchmarks anymore. They're winning on trust — SOC 2 compliance, data residency options, admin controls. The boring stuff that procurement teams actually care about.

• The Israeli Angle: At least two Israeli cybersecurity firms (one from the current 8200 cohort) are building dedicated Claude integrations for enterprise security workflows. When a platform becomes this entrenched, the ecosystem opportunity for builders is massive.

• Valuation Compression Is Coming: At $60B, Anthropic is now valued at ~30x forward revenue. That's aggressive. Founders building in the AI stack should watch how public markets react — it sets the ceiling for everyone downstream.

The takeaway: The AI companies that will win the enterprise aren't the ones with the best model. They're the ones whose customers trust them enough to write nine-figure checks. Trust is the real moat.

If you found this insightful, consider resharing 🔄 and follow me Tal Hacmon for more content like this.
